hero.title: BBA / BBA (Hons.) Majoring in AI & Emerging Technologies

panes.label: Overview
panes.text:
The BBA / BBA (Hons.) in Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies at ATLAS ISME is designed for future business leaders who are fluent in data, innovation and cutting-edge technologies. This interdisciplinary program merges core business principles with in-depth exposure to AI, machine learning, blockchain, IoT, robotics and quantum computing.

Students will not only gain a solid understanding of how these technologies function but also learn how to build businesses, craft strategies, and develop solutions powered by these advancements. Through a combination of real-world projects, startup collaborations, simulations and product labs, you’ll graduate with the skills to lead digital transformation, drive AI-based ventures and create competitive advantages in tech-driven industries. By the end of the program, you’ll be well-equipped to innovate and lead in the rapidly evolving world of AI and emerging technologies.

cards.title: Understand core AI and emerging tech concepts and their business applications
Design data-informed strategies for digital transformation and automation
Build machine learning models using real-world datasets and tools
Evaluate the business potential of technologies like blockchain, IoT and robotics
Collaborate across tech and business teams to drive innovation
Launch, manage or advise ventures that operate at the frontier of tech
Marketing
cards.text: Go beyond the fundamentals of branding and consumer behaviour. The Marketing minor equips you to develop impactful campaigns, understand audience insights and build standout brands in today’s competitive landscape.

cards.title: Family Managed Business
cards.text: Develop expertise in governance, succession, strategy, finance and leadership within family enterprises. Prepare to lead, professionalise and sustain multi-generational businesses in an evolving global business environment.

cards.title: Finance
cards.text: Master key financial concepts, including investment, valuation, and budgeting, to drive organisational growth. The Finance minor prepares you for careers in corporate finance, banking and investment management.

cards.title: Entrepreneurship
cards.text: Transform ideas into action by learning to launch ventures and drive innovation. This minor sharpens your creativity, leadership and problem-solving through real-world projects and collaboration.

cards.title: Economics
cards.text: Explore the economic forces and policies shaping global businesses and markets. Learn how economic analysis informs decision-making and drives innovation through public policy.

cards.title: Digital Branding & Advertising
cards.text: Master digital marketing strategies, create compelling brand identities, and design effective campaigns to engage and grow online audiences.

cards.title: Business Analytics
cards.text: Harness data to drive smarter business decisions. Learn to analyse trends, visualise information and use quantitative tools to impact marketing, finance, and strategy with data-driven insights.

cards.title: Business Psychology
cards.text: Explore how psychological principles influence workplace behaviour, leadership, decision-making and team dynamics to optimise performance and culture.

courses.text: Learn the core management functions of planning, organising, leading and controlling to effectively manage teams and organisations.
